title: alsine glauca
intro: Alsine glauca, commonly known as Purple Wood Sorrel or Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Saxifragaceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Alsine glauca include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in soothing skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of Alsine glauca include tannins, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
